```python
    n = len(grid)
    def map_index(index):
        row = (index - 1) // n
        col = (index - 1) % n
        return grid[row][col]
    return ''.join(map(map_index, indexes))
```

```python
def grid_index(grid, indexes):
    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(grid, list) or not all(isinstance(row, list) and len(row) == len(grid) for row in grid):
        raise ValueError("Invalid grid")
    if not all(isinstance(i, int) for i in indexes):
        raise ValueError("Invalid indexes")
    
    # Convert indexes to 2D coordinates
    coords = [(i - 1) // len(grid), (i - 1) % len(grid) for i in indexes]
    
    # Validate 2D coordinates
    if any(c < 0 or c >= len(grid) for c in coords[0]) or any(c < 0 or c >= len(grid[0]) for c in coords[1]):
        raise ValueError("Index out of bounds")
    
    # Build output string
    output = ""
    for c in coords:
        output += grid[c[0]][c[1]]
    
    return output
```
